title: Explaining what Mark OK covers, on the three phone screens
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. An inspection on desktop and on a phone with sections and a per-axle field.
custom_steps:
1. At each level, open the on-demand explanation and confirm it says what it covers, what it leaves alone, and that values are never filled in; on a phone, confirm the inspection-level caption reads '34 items are still Not inspected. Only those are marked OK; verdicts already picked stay, and values are never filled in.' (the number is the live count).
2. On a phone, confirm the three levels take three surfaces — the section header, the axle field's sub-header, and the app-bar menu — and the footer stays section navigation and gains nothing; on the last section, confirm Back is a compact arrow button beside 'Submit & Generate Report', which is never truncated.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each level explains its scope on demand: what it covers, what it leaves alone, and that values are never filled in.
  • On a phone the inspection-level caption reads: '34 items are still Not inspected. Only those are marked OK; verdicts already picked stay, and values are never filled in.' (the number is the live count).
  • On a phone the three levels take three surfaces — the section header, the axle field's sub-header, and the app-bar menu — and the footer stays section navigation and gains nothing.
  • On the last section the footer keeps Back, as a compact arrow button, beside 'Submit & Generate Report', which is never truncated.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9883 (S18 — Mark a whole scope OK in one press); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S18; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-R10: “Each level will explain its scope on demand: what it covers, what it leaves alone, and that values are never filled in. On a phone the inspection-level caption reads: '34 items are still Not inspected. Only those are marked OK; verdicts already picked stay, and values are never filled in.'”
  • S18-R11: “On a phone the three levels take three surfaces — the section header, the axle field's sub-header, and the app-bar menu. The footer stays section navigation and gains nothing. On the last section the footer keeps Back, as a compact arrow button, beside 'Submit & Generate Report', which is never truncated”

Amended on 5 October 2026
S18-R10 and S18-R11 changed on 5 October 2026 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905 (read on 5 October 2026)): the phone's inspection-level caption has a set wording, and on the last section the phone footer keeps Back as a compact arrow beside 'Submit & Generate Report'. The quotes above are the current wording, and the steps and expected results follow them.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
